name: browser
description: Authenticated loopback-only Playwright browser daemon with fail-closed request interception, private-network blocking, bounded interaction APIs, and restorable local state

capabilities.name: browser.automation
capabilities.description: Drive Chromium, Firefox, or WebKit through an authenticated 127.0.0.1 HTTP API; every HTTP(S) navigation and subresource request is checked by the shared outbound network policy

credentials.name: AGENT_FORGE_BROWSER_TOKEN
credentials.description: Optional explicit bearer token; otherwise a random token is stored at _runtime/auth/browser.token

health_checks.description: Verify the authenticated browser daemon and shared security policy import

storage.description: Persisted browser storage-state.json and screenshots under _runtime/browser/
Locally generated daemon bearer token; never printed or committed

security.authentication: Bearer token required for every endpoint
security.network: HTTP(S) targets and subresources must resolve exclusively to public addresses; redirects are revalidated
security.websockets: blocked by default; explicit operator override required
security.javascript: arbitrary evaluation blocked by default; explicit trusted-session override required
